name: UF-style-minimal
note: minimal — few colors, lots of empty space. PICO-8 palette, 128x128. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 1. Twin of FACTORY/style-minimal.  (sample: seed 1485)

form.subject: a lone (lighthouse:1.3) on a small rocky island at dusk, (calm sea:0.9)
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (busy, cluttered:1.2)

sample_command: pixelmon 'a lone (lighthouse:1.3) on a small rocky island at dusk, (calm sea:0.9)' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora pixel-art-xl.safetensors --lora-strength 1 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (busy, cluttered:1.2)' --style minimal --out 128x128 --palette PICO-8 --despeckle 1 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --seed 1485
